description: This Java source file implements a command strategy for creating a new client within the Fineract batch API. It handles invoking the ClientsApiResource's create method and wraps the response or error into a BatchResponse.

classes.name: CreateClientCommandStrategy
classes.description: A command strategy component that handles creating a new client by delegating to ClientsApiResource and forming the BatchResponse.
